name: Ars Poetica
long_description:
Ars Poetica is a poetry-themed narrative-focused escape-room puzzle game.
Think "Zorg meets Dear Esther" - story-focused, vanguardist in its puzzle design, but rooted in the genre of the text adventure, merging old-school and contemporary game design.
A World War II soldier gets injured in battle. In his journey back home he's killed by a bombshell - and in this split second, between life and death, he must now find peace, and remember who he is.

Note: this download is hosted on an external server, not GitHub, and may stop working if that server goes down or changes without the catalog knowing.
